verdict: Original 3.3 V / 0.50 A source cannot reliably power the assumed 5 V pump and MCU

calculation.note: Pump power alone exceeds assumed 3.3 V source capacity after realistic conversion loss, before MCU and startup current.

repair: Use a separate correctly rated regulated 5 V pump supply, sized above nominal 0.30 A for measured startup/inrush and safe switching; provide a proper 3.3 V MCU rail, a suitable pump driver, and defined return/ground strategy. Alternative: select an appropriate battery/supply and independently verify peak load, converter efficiency, heat and safety.
required_next_tests: Select an actual supply and driver
Verify power rails/grounds and electrical safety
